A QUICK GUIDE · EASY ENGLISH / ROMAN URDU

How Milaan works.

  1. 1. Add orders and your statement.

    Upload your order list with each seller-assigned Order number, and the CSV of money received in your account. Choose the real dates covered by the statement. You can ask your bank or wallet provider for an export if you cannot find the CSV option. Do not guess the statement dates.

  2. 2. Add the customer's payment screenshot.

    Link each screenshot to the matching Order number. The Transaction ID appears on the customer's payment confirmation screen or receipt. Look for the same number in your statement. Enter details yourself, or ask for AI reading only if you agree to send the image to Google. Check everything before saving.

  3. 3. Compare the payment.

    Milaan compares the full Transaction ID, exact PKR amount, receiving account and payment status with your statement. Confirm that the IDs correspond. One statement credit cannot pay for two orders automatically.

  4. 4. Review and decide.

    SHIP: one full matching credit with confirmed evidence. HOLD: no matching credit found after the necessary checks. REVIEW: something is missing, unclear or needs your decision. Export your decisions after checking them.

Illustrative example — not a real payment

Order number: 1042; amount: PKR 3,500. Customer screenshot: successful PKR 3,500, Transaction ID MLN778810. Seller statement: one PKR 3,500 credit with the same complete Transaction ID. If all required evidence is confirmed, Milaan shows SHIP. MLN is fictional demo data, not a Milaan ID format.

What if the Transaction ID is missing or wrong?

Missing or partial Transaction ID: REVIEW (a possible amount/time match may appear, otherwise ask for a complete number). Transaction ID present but amount wrong: REVIEW. The same Transaction ID on two orders: REVIEW for both. A complete Transaction ID and exact amount alone do not guarantee SHIP: the receipt, account, status, time and statement also need checking.

When will Milaan automatically suggest SHIP?

Only after all checks pass: (1) the receipt is confirmed as payment evidence and its fields are checked; (2) the receipt status is exactly one of success, successful, completed, paid, payment successful, transaction successful (case and surrounding spaces do not matter); (3) the receiving account and PKR amount match the Order number and order total; (4) the seller declares a complete statement period that covers the payment time; (5) the customer's full Transaction ID matches exactly one credit with the exact amount; (6) the credit and receipt timestamps are no more than 24 hours apart; (7) the seller confirms the sender's and receiver's Transaction IDs correspond; and (8) there is no duplicate proof or credit, reversal/refund or prior allocation conflict. A name or amount/time similarity by itself only suggests REVIEW. Milaan does not verify settlement with the bank or ship orders.

Statement CSV help

Ask your bank or wallet provider for a statement export showing money received in your own account. If the file has different column names, map them in the Import center. A saved statement needs posted_at, direction, amount, counterparty, transaction_id, account_id and optional currency (PKR); order CSV needs order_ref, customer_name, amount_due, account_id. Use UTF-8 CSV with ISO date/time (for example 2026-10-09T14:22:00+05:00), amounts in PKR, up to 2,000 records and 2 MB per file. PDF and Excel statement import are not supported; request or convert to CSV first. Sample orders CSV · Sample statement CSV.

Know the limits

The no-signup demo uses fictional records in your browser. To save your own records, you need an account with an email and password; new registration may be temporarily unavailable. Milaan compares only records you supply, not a live bank. AI can misread screenshots. The default batch expiry is seven days; stored file cleanup can run later. You make the shipping decision.

  1. 1. Orders aur statement add karein.

    Apni order list mein seller ka Order number aur account mein aane wali payments ki CSV upload karein. Statement ki asal start aur end dates dalein. Agar CSV na mile, Easypaisa, JazzCash ya bank se statement export ka tareeqa pooch lein. Dates andazay se na dalein.

  2. 2. Customer ka payment screenshot add karein.

    Screenshot ko sahi Order number se link karein. Transaction ID customer ki payment confirmation screen ya receipt par hota hai. Seller ko yehi number statement mein dekhna hai. Details khud enter karein, ya apni marzi se Google AI ko screenshot bhejein. Save karne se pehle sab check karein.

  3. 3. Payment compare karein.

    Milaan poora Transaction ID, bilkul same PKR amount, account aur payment status statement se milata hai. Confirm karein ke dono taraf IDs match karte hain. Ek statement credit ko do orders ke liye automatically use nahi kiya jata.

  4. 4. Result check karke faisla karein.

    SHIP: saari zaroori tasdeeq ke saath ek poori matching payment. HOLD: checks ke baad statement mein payment na mile. REVIEW: koi detail missing ho ya khud check karna zaroori ho. Phir apna result export karein.

Sirf samjhane ke liye example

Order number 1042 hai aur amount PKR 3,500 hai. Screenshot par successful PKR 3,500 aur Transaction ID MLN778810 hai. Statement mein bhi same poora number aur ek PKR 3,500 credit hai. Saari baqi conditions confirm hon to SHIP milega. MLN sirf fictional demo ka number hai, Milaan ka format nahi.

Number missing ya galat ho to?

Transaction ID missing ya adhoora ho: REVIEW. Kabhi amount/time se possible match mil sakta hai, warna poora number manga jata hai. Number sahi magar amount galat: REVIEW. Ek hi poora number do orders par: dono REVIEW. SHIP ke liye sirf amount aur number kafi nahi.

Automatic SHIP kab suggest hota hai?

Sirf jab sab conditions poori hon: (1) receipt aur uski fields check karke confirm ki gayi hon; (2) payment status in mein se ho: success, successful, completed, paid, payment successful, transaction successful; (3) receiving account aur exact PKR amount Order number ke total se milta ho; (4) seller ne statement ka asal complete start/end period declare kiya ho aur payment us mein aati ho; (5) customer ka poora Transaction ID statement ke exactly ek credit se same ho aur amount bhi bilkul same ho; (6) receipt aur statement credit ki timing mein 24 ghantay se zyada farq na ho; (7) seller ne sender aur receiver ke Transaction IDs ki correspondence confirm ki ho; (8) proof repeat, duplicate credit, refund/reversal ya pehle allocated credit ka conflict na ho. Sirf naam, amount ya time ki similarity SHIP nahi banati. Milaan bank se payment confirm nahi karta aur order khud ship nahi karta.

Statement CSV ka tareeqa

Apne bank ya wallet se account mein aane wali payments ka statement export lein. Agar columns ke naam different hon to Import center mein mapping kar sakte hain. Statement CSV mein posted_at, direction, amount, counterparty, transaction_id aur account_id chahiye; orders CSV mein order_ref, customer_name, amount_due aur account_id. Dates ISO format mein hon, amounts PKR mein, maximum 2,000 rows aur 2 MB. PDF ya Excel ka direct import nahi hota, pehle CSV mein convert karein. Orders example · Statement example.

Zaroori baat

Demo fictional data se browser mein chalta hai, account nahi chahiye. Apne asli records save karne ke liye email aur password se account chahiye; naya signup filhaal band ho sakta hai. Milaan bank se connect nahi hota, AI se ghalti ho sakti hai. Batch ki default expiry saat din hai, files baad mein cleanup ho sakti hain. Aakhri faisla aap ka hai.
